validates: MECH-357 (ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression + instrumental-avoidance action pathway + eligibility-trace efficacy learning) -- SD-029 scheduled-external-hazard successor of V3-EXQ-603s's mobile-predator design, replacing an undirected continuous-drift pressure (which 603s's own per-seed data showed collapses to a spawn-position lottery) with a discrete, agent-relative threat-onset event, per mech357_freeze_incompatible_pressure_scoping_2026-08-10.md
reuse_check_note: GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readout (G_H_LESION_frac + the INTACT-beats-LESION discrimination under an SD-029 SCHEDULED EXTERNAL-HAZARD Stage-H) is a NEW manipulation (scheduled_external_hazard_enabled=True, never previously used in this lineage -- 603g/603h/603r ran the static default, 603s ran undirected mobile-predator drift) present in no recorded run. Not reanalysis-recoverable -> ran fresh.
design_note: SD-029 scheduled-external-hazard successor of V3-EXQ-603s, per mech357_freeze_incompatible_pressure_scoping_2026-08-10.md. 603s's mobile-predator field (env_drift interval=1/prob=0.6) FAILED discrimination on an EXACT TIE (G_H_LESION_frac == G_H_INTACT_frac == 0.6667). The scoping spike traced this to env_drift being UNDIRECTED -- hazards never target the agent -- which on a 10x10 grid with 4 fast hazards produces a spawn-position lottery rather than a graded conflict (603s's own per-seed data is strictly bimodal: 200-step ceiling or ~5.5-6-step self-contamination death, nothing between). 603t replaces that with SD-029 scheduled_external_hazard (interval=20, prob=0.9, adjacent_only=True), an already-built, previously-unused CausalGridWorldV2 mechanism that deterministically places a hazard adjacent to the agent's CURRENT position on a schedule -- agent-relative and discrete by construction, removing the spawn-lottery confound. Ambient env_drift reverted to defaults (5, 0.3) so the discrete injection is the isolated new pressure variable rather than stacking on 603s's confounded drift. 3 arms x 3 seeds [42,43,44] with the same TWO-SIDED discriminative-headroom guard as 603s (unchanged: it worked as designed there -- the mechanism, not the guard, is what changed): ARM_LESION (negative control) must FAIL the gate (headroom from below); ARM_POSCTRL (gated + reef spawn, positive control) must CLEAR it (survivability exists / pressure not impossible). A mis-calibrated schedule self-routes to a requeue rather than a false MECH-357 verdict.

preconditions.name: pavlovian_freeze_reaction_present_on_lesion
preconditions.description: MECH-279 PAG freeze must commit on the LESION arm (pag_n_commits > 0 on >= 2/3 seeds) -- the Pavlovian reaction the ilPFC suppresses. Below-floor => no freeze to suppress => vacuous contrast => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: ARM_LESION: PAG on, harm stream fed, both combined fixes on, SD-029 scheduled hazard -- the freeze reaction must still fire.

preconditions.name: ilpfc_gate_engages_and_suppresses_freeze_on_intact
preconditions.description: On the INTACT arm the ilPFC gate must register efficacy updates under threat (n_credit+n_decay>0) AND suppress the PAG freeze (n_freeze_suppressed>0) on >= 2/3 seeds. Below-floor => gate never engaged => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: ARM_INTACT: gate on + protective-scaffold floor 0.8 + both fixes.

preconditions.name: stage0_forced_feed_lights_zgoal_on_intact
preconditions.description: Stage-0 forced supra-threshold benefit lights z_goal (>0.4) on >=2/3 INTACT seeds -- the goal-FORMATION positive control.

preconditions.name: discriminative_headroom_below_lesion_fails_gate
preconditions.description: The SD-029 scheduled-hazard pressure must make the LESION negative control FAIL the survival gate (G_H_LESION < 2/3) -- i.e. it reintroduced the Pavlovian-instrumental conflict that 603s's spawn-lottery-confounded field could not discriminate. Measured = 1 - G_H_LESION_frac so the floor semantics match: below floor => LESION still ceilinged => pressure_insufficient_lesion_ceiling_requeue.
preconditions.control: ARM_LESION under SD-029 scheduled hazard (interval=20, prob=0.9, adjacent_only=True).

preconditions.name: survivability_exists_above_posctrl_clears_gate
preconditions.description: The pressure must not be impossible: a gated agent spawned in the reef refuge (best case) must clear the survival gate (G_H_POSCTRL >= 2/3). Below-floor => pressure too lethal for ANY policy => pressure_impossible_requeue, NOT a MECH-357 weakens.
preconditions.control: ARM_POSCTRL: gate on + reef spawn + both fixes, SD-029 scheduled hazard.
